summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 new features for iWhistle B2B Partnership Portal: Form validation with inline errors, PDF generation using jsPDF, and Admin Dashboard with full CRUD operations. All 24 test scenarios passed successfully including backend APIs, frontend UI, and end-to-end integrations.
passed_tests: Form validation: Submit with empty fields shows validation summary banner with error count
Form validation: Required fields marked with red asterisk (*) - found 23 asterisks
Form validation: Email validation works for contactEmail and championEmail fields
Form validation: numOfficials validates minimum 10 (shows error for value 5)
Form validation: perUserRate validates > 0 (shows error for value 0)
Form validation: endDate validates after startDate (shows error for invalid date order)
Form validation: Errors clear when user fixes fields (tested contactEmail and numOfficials)
Form validation: 21 inline error messages display correctly in red text
PDF Generation: Download PDF button generates actual PDF files with proper filename
PDF Generation: PDF includes form data and price calculations ($4320 for 30 officials at $12/month)
PDF Generation: Works from both Fill Form tab and Preview Agreement tab
PDF Generation: Preview Agreement tab shows formatted text with populated form data
Form submission: Submit Application sends data to /api/partnerships successfully
Form submission: Success message displays after successful submission
Admin Dashboard: /admin route renders admin dashboard with proper layout
Admin Dashboard: Stats cards show Total Applications (2), Pending Review (0), Approved (1), Total Value ($5,040)
Admin Dashboard: Partnerships table displays existing applications with proper data
Admin Dashboard: View (eye icon) opens detail modal with all partnership information
Admin Dashboard: Status buttons work - successfully changed status to approved
Admin Dashboard: Search input filters partnerships by name/email
Admin Dashboard: Status filter dropdown with options (all, pending, approved, rejected)
Admin Dashboard: Back to Site link navigates to main site correctly
Admin Dashboard: Refresh button updates data successfully
Backend API: GET /api/admin/partnerships returns partnerships with IDs (tested 2 partnerships)
Backend API: GET /api/admin/stats returns correct counts and totals
Backend API: PUT /api/admin/partnerships/{id}/status updates status successfully
Backend API: DELETE /api/admin/partnerships/{id} removes partnership successfully
Footer: Admin Dashboard link navigates to /admin route correctly
